# Code of conduct

Be respectful. Disagree about the code, not about people. No harassment, insults, or personal attacks, in issues,
pull requests, or anywhere the project is discussed.

This project follows the spirit of the [Contributor Covenant 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
To report a problem, email altybanony@gmail.com. Reports are handled privately, and comments, commits or issues that
break these rules may be removed.
